description: Report the outcome after doing a task on a website, with or without a playbook. Simplest form: {report_token (from get_playbook), success}. A report keeps the playbook working for your next run, and the reply shows its updated success rate. Without a token, send site, task, playbook_id and outcome. Typed values and personal data are redacted on receipt; still, never include passwords or payment details.

playbook_id.description: from get_playbook, if one was used

report_token.description: from get_playbook; with it, only success is needed

shortcut_id.description: the playbook shortcut used, if any

shortcut_used.description: the playbook shortcut used, if any

steps.description: what you did, step by step

steps_log.description: what you did, step by step

name: submit_trace
title: Report a run
